scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Educational Institution Doing Outstanding Work In Awareness Generation And Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse
other_conditions: Open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
An institution or individual that has previously received the award is ineligible for the next three award cycles
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized agency or person
Only nominations/recommendations from authorized agencies or persons, supported by adequate justification, will be considered
Educational institutions must have at least five years of work in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse, with ongoing activities preferred
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹2,00,000.
